newsitem.title: POLAND: Swarzedz surges on debt deal hopes.
newsitem.headline: Swarzedz surges on debt deal hopes.

text.p: Polish furniture maker Swarzedz SA surged 9.4 percent to 11.6 zlotys on hopes that its meeting with creditors on Monday would result in a debt-restructuring deal, traders said.

Swarzedz, which owes 60.5 million zlotys, has already announced a preliminary agreement with its main creditors under which they would purchase 3.1 million new Swarzedz shares, proceeds from which would help pay off debts.
Swarzedz, which did not trade after price-fixing on Monday due to excess demand, is due to announce the results of the meeting at a news conference after 1330 GMT.
